charms.name: ASTRA
charms.title: THE STEADY LYRE
charms.line: One star for every day studied without a buff.

charms.name: NOVA
charms.title: THE BURNING STAR
charms.line: Two stars for a day of 3 hours or more, buffs or not. Short days light nothing.

charms.name: NEBULA
charms.title: THE SLOW CLOUD
charms.line: One star for any day with 30 minutes logged, buffs or not. Holds the fewest.

calendar.name: SETSUBUN
calendar.tagline: Out with the demons. Handful by handful.
calendar.rule: ONI hates small things thrown often: logs of 30 minutes or less hit for double.

calendar.name: VALENTINE
calendar.tagline: Someone has been studying very hard, for someone.
calendar.rule: CHOCO is studying to impress one person and will not lose. BITTER, the boss, dodges every fourth hit.

calendar.name: HANAMI
calendar.tagline: The blossoms only stay a little while.
calendar.rule: FUBUKI is the storm that strips the trees: it grows back after every empty day. SAKURA, the transfer student, stays until the last petal.

calendar.name: TANABATA
calendar.tagline: Two stars, one night a year.
calendar.rule: The RIVER OF HEAVEN is a dragon of stars with one head per subject: each log only reaches its own.

calendar.name: SUMMER BREAK
calendar.tagline: There is plenty of time. There was.
calendar.rule: AUGUST 31 is the deadline itself: every empty day it grows back two hours.

calendar.name: TSUKIMI
calendar.tagline: Look up. Someone up there is keeping count.
calendar.rule: TSUKUYOMI rules the night and heals an hour at every midnight. USAGI pounds rice on the moon between lessons.

calendar.name: HALLOWEEN
calendar.tagline: Some things only come out after dark.
calendar.rule: JACK can only be hit at night: logs committed from 05:00 to 17:59 pass right through.

calendar.name: CULTURE FESTIVAL
calendar.tagline: The whole school is awake and nothing is ready.
calendar.rule: STAGE FRIGHT only shows itself after dark, the night before you go on. The class president, IINCHO, is running everything.

calendar.name: CHRISTMAS
calendar.tagline: He has one night, and he has not started.
calendar.rule: Log 5 hours from Dec 20 to 24 and a present opens on the 25th: a limited piece, free.

calendar.name: NEW YEAR
calendar.tagline: Start the year with a clean page.
calendar.rule: KAGAMI, the offering come to life, only feels one long sitting: logs under an hour bounce off. MIKO keeps the shrine, and the hours.

buffs.name: WARM-UP
buffs.detail: Every log you commit in the next 48h earns +100 BITS/h until 5 hours are covered (up to +500). A cheap first buff.

timing.note: Your next commit counts, even for study you did before buying.

buffs.name: NIGHT SHIFT
buffs.detail: For 72h, sessions touching 22:00–02:00 earn +100 BITS/h the first night, +150 the next and +200 the third, up to 3 hours a night (+1,350 in all). Skip a night and the rate drops back to +100.

timing.note: Pays on sessions that touch 22:00–02:00. After midnight still counts as the night before.

buffs.name: EARLY BIRD
buffs.tagline: ×3 at dawn — skip a morning and it ends
buffs.detail: The next 3 mornings: sessions touching 05:00–09:00 earn +200 BITS/h, up to 2 hours each morning (+1,200 in all). A morning with no log ends the buff, and whatever is left of it is lost.

timing.note: Log during 05:00–09:00 every morning, or it ends.

buffs.name: MYSTERY CRATE
buffs.tagline: One random buff — maybe a HYPERDRIVE
buffs.detail: Opens into one of the other buffs (not CATEGORY LOCK), which starts right away with its usual rules. Rare ones are rare.

timing.note: It opens right away, then follows the rules of whatever is inside.

buffs.name: OVERCLOCK
buffs.detail: For the next 24h every log earns +100 BITS/h, up to 10 hours (+1,000). Short and sharp: whatever is left after a day is gone.

timing.note: Your next commit counts, even for study you did before buying.

buffs.name: STORM RUNNER
buffs.detail: For 5 days, logs committed while the CHRONOMETER weather reads rain, snow, a storm or below 0°C earn +100 BITS/h (up to 10 hours, +1,000). Clear skies pay the usual rate. Needs the weather readout switched on.

timing.note: Pays only if it is raining, snowing, stormy or below 0°C when you commit.

buffs.name: FOCUS CHIP
buffs.tagline: +100 per 50-min session — a short log burns it out
buffs.detail: For 72h, each single log of 50 minutes or more earns +100 BITS (up to 12 logs, +1,200). Commit a log under 25 minutes and the chip burns out: the buff ends.

timing.note: Your next commit counts, even for study you did before buying.

buffs.name: CATEGORY LOCK
buffs.detail: Pick a category: for 72h its logs earn +100 BITS/h (up to 12 hours, +1,200). Logs in other categories earn the usual rate.

timing.note: Your next commit counts, even for study you did before buying.

buffs.name: LUNAR TIDE
buffs.tagline: Pays with the moon — ×2 at full
buffs.detail: For 96h, each log earns extra BITS in step with the moon: +100 BITS/h at full moon, about +50 at a half moon, close to nothing at new moon (up to 12 hours). Check the LUNAR CALENDAR before you buy.

timing.note: Your next commit counts, even for study you did before buying.

buffs.name: WEEKEND SURGE
buffs.detail: Sessions touching this Saturday and Sunday earn +50 BITS/h (up to 24 hours, +1,200). Buy it any day — it holds your buff slot until Sunday ends.

timing.note: Pays on Saturday and Sunday only, by the time you commit.

buffs.name: LUCKY BYTE
buffs.detail: For 72h, each log has a 1-in-5 chance to pay triple (up to 3h of it counts; up to 20 logs).

timing.note: Your next commit counts, even for study you did before buying.

buffs.name: DEEP DIVE
buffs.tagline: The longer the session, the bigger the haul
buffs.detail: For 96h, each single log pays by its length: 2h or more earns +300, 3h +450 and 4h +700 (up to 4 logs, +2,800). Shorter logs pay nothing extra and use nothing up.

timing.note: Your next commit counts, even for study you did before buying.

buffs.name: IRON CONTRACT
buffs.tagline: 3 days × 5h: pays ×2 — or keeps the stake
buffs.detail: Starts at midnight and runs 3 calendar days. Log 5 hours or more on every one of them (a session past midnight counts for the day it started, if committed by 03:00) and the log that completes day 3 pays twice the stake (+3,000). Miss a single day and the stake is gone. Cancelling refunds nothing.

timing.note: Today's study doesn't count. The first of its days is tomorrow.

buffs.name: HYPERDRIVE
buffs.tagline: ×2 on 25 hours — if you keep up 3h a day
buffs.detail: Every log you commit in the next 96h earns +100 BITS/h until 25 hours are covered (up to +2,500). Every full day it runs needs 3 hours of logs (a session past midnight counts for the day it started, if committed by 03:00), or the drive shuts down.

timing.note: Today is free. From tomorrow it needs 3 hours of logs every full day.

raids.name: WARDEN
raids.title: KEEPER OF THE STREAK
raids.trait_line: A full day without a log heals it 2 hours.

raids.name: HYDRA
raids.title: THREE HEADS, THREE SUBJECTS
raids.trait_line: One head per category: a log only hits its own.

raids.name: TITAN
raids.title: THE LONG WAR
raids.trait_line: 40 hours of HP and a week to bring it down.

rivals.name: MIKA
rivals.motto: Every stop on the train is a page.

offer.name: MIKA // INVERTED
offer.tag: MISSED THE LAST TRAIN ON PURPOSE
offer.motto: Every stop. Every day. No days off.
offer.rule_line: Win all three rounds, or you lose the duel.

rivals.name: NOVA
rivals.motto: The night is where the work is.

rivals.name: KAI
rivals.motto: Twenty-five on, five off. All day.

rivals.name: ORION
rivals.motto: Four hours a day. Every day.

rivals.name: ACE
rivals.motto: Second place is just the first to lose.

items.name: STEADY HAND
items.detail: Asks nothing and gives a little. The plainest blessing, and the only one that never misses.

items.name: GRACE
items.effect: Minutes round up to the next 5
items.detail: Logs of 10 minutes or more count as if they ran to the next five. Worth most on odd, short logs; nothing on ones that end on a five.

items.name: FIRST LIGHT
items.effect: +15 BITS on the day's first log
items.detail: Pays once a day, on the first log, if it runs 45 minutes or more. A big share for one sitting a day; a small one for long days.

items.name: SPRINTER
items.detail: For short bursts: pays on logs of 10 to 30 minutes, on the first five of them each day.

items.name: MARATHON
items.detail: For long sittings only. Anything shorter than an hour and a half earns nothing from it.

items.name: HEARTH
items.effect: +1% per day in a row, up to +6%
items.detail: Grows with the days logged in a row before the log's own date. Miss one and it starts again from nothing.

items.name: HOMECOMING
items.effect: +16% on a subject left for 3 days
items.detail: Pays on logs of 15 minutes or more in a subject you had studied before but not in the three days before this one. Rewards moving between subjects.

items.name: SABBATH
items.detail: Only the weekend counts (the log's date), however long the logs are.

items.name: TENACITY
items.effect: Later logs of the day earn more
items.detail: The day's third log of 20 minutes or more gets +6%, the fourth +10%, every one after that +15%. The first two get nothing.

items.name: ASCENDANT
items.detail: Every day has its own tide, drawn in secret: anywhere from nothing to +12% on all of that day's logs. You only see it in what they earn.

assets.name: AERO DYNAMICS
assets.tagline: Fighter jets and big contracts — quiet for days, then a step up
assets.detail: A defence prime that barely moves between contracts. When one lands the price jumps a notch, and the new level tends to hold.

assets.name: AEGIS SYSTEMS
assets.tagline: Air defence and armour — strongest when everything else is weak
assets.detail: Where money hides when the rest of the market sells off. It edges up on bad days for everyone else, and lags when the market is euphoric.

assets.name: ORBITAL LAUNCH
assets.tagline: Private rockets — long silences, then a launch
assets.detail: A launch company waiting on its next flight. It sags while it waits; a successful launch sends it soaring before it settles back about halfway.

assets.name: VOLT GRID
assets.tagline: Transformers and power lines — a slow, straight climb
assets.detail: Every data centre needs power. It climbs at a gentle, almost straight angle; the calmest growth on the board.

assets.name: ATOM CORE
assets.tagline: Reactors and uranium — big swells that keep rising
assets.detail: Energy demand comes in waves, and this rides them: swells and dips of uneven length, each low a little higher than the last.

assets.name: TERRA NEXUS
assets.tagline: Wind, solar and batteries — jittery, but growing
assets.detail: Plenty of day-to-day noise, but averaged over a couple of weeks it grows steadily. Medium risk.

assets.name: SILICON FOUNDRY
assets.tagline: AI chips — runs for days, then a sharp pullback
assets.detail: The market's favourite. Once it starts climbing it can run for days, and the longer it runs the more likely a sharp pullback becomes. Timing is the game.

assets.name: SENTINEL EYE
assets.tagline: Security and intelligence AI — wild swings, steep growth
assets.detail: Big moves inside the day and a steep climb over weeks. For trades of a few days to a few weeks.

assets.name: QUANTUM MATRIX
assets.tagline: Quantum computing venture — double or half in a day
assets.detail: The roughest ride on the board: it can lose half its value and still be the best performer over a month. Traded at three times leverage, which slowly eats into anyone who just sits on it.

assets.name: GENOME LABS
assets.tagline: Next-generation drugs — quiet, then an approval
assets.detail: Dull for long stretches, drifting lower while trials run. An approval sends it straight up, and about half of that comes back over the next days.

news.headline: PHASE III TRIAL MEETS ITS ENDPOINT

assets.name: BIONIC MED
assets.tagline: Surgical robots — steady growth with bursts
assets.detail: Hospitals keep buying. A steady climb, with runs of a few days when the market notices it.

assets.name: AGRI HARVEST
assets.tagline: Autonomous farming — its own seasons, out of step with the rest
assets.detail: Moves with the harvest, not with the market: swells and dips of its own that rarely line up with anything else on the board.

assets.name: OCEAN FREIGHT
assets.tagline: Global shipping — clear tides of boom and lull
assets.detail: Freight rates come and go in tides you can see on the chart, though no two are the same length or height. Each low tends to sit above the last.

assets.name: RARE EARTH
assets.tagline: Gold, copper and lithium — up when tech is down
assets.detail: Hard assets that keep their value. It tends to rise when chips and AI are being sold, which makes it a natural partner for them.

assets.name: GLOBAL 500
assets.tagline: The whole market in one fund — if in doubt, this
assets.detail: Moves with the board as a whole: it never runs the hottest, never falls the hardest, and over a month or more it climbs. No cap: the calm place for savings.
